_about: Permanent parser regression fixtures — REAL dispatch texts the boss actually sends. Append a new object to "fixtures" whenever a real text surfaces a case worth guarding. The suite (tests/test_parser_real_texts.py) runs each text through the live /api/parse LLM parser and asserts the structured output. It runs strict assertions when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (locally or in CI with a key) and skips cleanly otherwise. Never delete a fixture — that's the whole point (permanent regression guard).

_matchers.oneof_ci: list — the value must equal one of these (case-insensitive)
_matchers.regex: case-insensitive re.search over the field value
_matchers._note: A field's matchers ALL must pass. 'fields' are hard (fail the suite). 'advisory' matchers are reported with a ⚠ but never fail — used for LLM-nuance we want to watch but not gate on yet.

fixtures.text: Pr 7021 harbor view blvd,suff,Ew 40yd dump holland

After harbor view
Pr 1013 paragon way,suff, napo 3085 at vista 23 dump holland

Before you return paragon use it to
Pr 527 j Clyde Morris blvd,newpt, Serv pro 30yd dump holland then return it to paragon

advisory._why: The preamble asks to bring the empty from the Paragon pull to this stop. Whether the model encodes that as empty_can_plan is a nuance we watch but don't gate on yet — promote to a hard field once confirmed against a live key.
